title: Sandboxed blueprint bundle vs a trivial control bot: timeout and error rates
description: Run with --jobs 1 on an otherwise idle machine. Checks that the bundle loads and plays under the submission sandbox (1 GiB, 1 ms decisions) and reports its timeout rate next to a trivial control in the same seat (the machine's timeout floor); too small for an effect estimate. Single-file strategy bots such as strategy/endgame/bots/points.py cannot load in the sandbox (they import the repository), so the control is a built-in baseline.
